Hero_Desc_Diana:
A wise elder trusted and followed by the werebeasts.
Denizens say that Diana has had quite a lively past.
Album_Hate_Diana: Efforts to forcibly open her eyes. Confusing roe deer and red deer.
Album_Hobby_Diana: Neighborhood Watch, pretending to take a walk.
Album_Diana1: An elder at Werebeast Village, she is also known as a sage. Despite the werebeasts living freely as they please, when things become complicated or difficult, they always seek Diana's counsel. In fact, she is practically the acting head or administrator of the village.
Album_Diana2: Diana appears younger than she is. Just like the sprites, it seems there's no limit when it comes to age for the denizens of Elias Forest. Some werebeasts talk of Diana's past as a formidable warrior... Could there be some truth to these rumors?
Album_Diana3: According to some werebeasts, when Diana was young, she hailed as the empress who brought peace to the werebeast regions. Though, it sounds like an embellished memory in my opinion.
Album_Diana4: Maybe it's because of her age, but Diana seems to require a lot of sleep. Sometimes, in her sleep, she mutters, 'The roe deer are so weak.' Whenever that happens, she clenches her fists without even realizing it.
Album_Diana5: Diana appears troubled by the antics of young werebeasts like Tig. Whenever a disturbance breaks out, she tries to gently reason with them, but these foolhardy and juvenile werebeasts seem to ignore what she has to say.
Album_Diana6: Tig once caused so much havoc she accidentally broke one of Diana's horns. After being called in by Diana, Tig went away for a while. When she returned, she came back quieter, with a soulless expression.
Album_Diana7: Tig claims to have seen Diana's "eyes." Could the fact that she always keeps them closed be tied to the hidden side of her?

LoveCall_Diana:
Hello, Master. This is Diana.
I climbed the hill behind the village this morning. When I reached the summit, I thought of you.
I found myself wishing that we could enjoy the beautiful view together.
Breathing the clear air and drinking from the spring makes the entire day feel refreshing~
Hiking truly is wonderful exercise.
It improves your health and lets you admire the scenery. What could be better?

When you have time, let us hike Elemental Mountain together.
Why Elemental Mountain in particular?
Because only after climbing Elemental Mountain can you say you have truly gone hiking.
It also gives us much more time together, which is another advantage.
I know an excellent route, and I shall share it especially with you.
Contact me whenever you please. Let us climb with light hearts and a refreshing spirit.
I shall wait to hear from you. Until then...
